indicator_name: Production of main industrial products in physical units by region, monthly
description: Производство основных видов промышленной продукции в натуральном выражении по регионам, помесячно
unit: physical units, as in item_name (Taldau's measureName)
methodology: Taldau 701608, January 2020 onward. Items: BNS's list of main products (OIL_CONDENSATE … PHARMA_OTHER) and further КПВЭД products (CRUDE_OIL … POLYPROPYLENE), chosen 2026-09-27 from the product tree of index 701622 (CRUDE_OIL has no series in 701608 -- use OIL_CONDENSATE; it is kept for the shipments). A region's value is absent where BNS keeps it confidential, so regions need not add up to the national figure. Re-downloaded weekly (refresh_days).
